First, note: US/Mountain is UTC-7 (standard time, no DST in 1639). Asia/Tokyo is UTC+9 (no DST in 1639).  
Time difference: 9 - (-7) = 16 hours ahead for Tokyo.  
7 AM + 16 hours = 23:00 (11 PM) same day.  
No date change because 7 + 16 = 23, still December 3, 1639.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1639-12-03 23:00
